_comment: Template for the unisign_rgb_pose_slt model bundle manifest. Copy to <bundle-dir>/manifest.json and adjust the relative paths. All path fields resolve relative to the bundle directory (absolute paths also work). models/ is gitignored, so live bundles never enter the repository; this template is the committed reconstruction recipe. alignment_dir MUST be the npz directory (artifacts/.../pose) whose metadata_json carries alignment.best_start -- the JSON alignment directory is NOT supported and is rejected at load time.
